gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing in front of Lot 619 in D.D. 10 Lamma Island, New Territories and running in a south-westerly direction for about 215 metres where it terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/IS/R5B.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由新界南丫島第十約第六一九號地段前面起，向西南伸展約二百一十五米止。在NTA/IS/R5B號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing near the South Lamma Community Centre and running in a south-westerly direction for about 160 metres where it bends south south-easterly for about 15 metres and curves to run south-westerly for about 50 metres before it curves to run south-easterly for about 30 metres where it terminates near the Tin Hau Temple as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/IS/R5B.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由南丫南社區中心附近起，向西南伸展約一百六十米，然後向東南偏南伸展十五米，再向西南伸展約五十米；再向東南伸展約三十米至天后廟附近止。在NTA/IS/R5B號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing near the South Lamma Rural Committee building and running in a south-westerly direction for about 65 metres where it bends south-easterly for about 10 metres; it then curves to run south-westerly for about 85 metres and terminates at its junction with SOK KWU WAN SECOND STREET as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/IS/R5B.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由南丫南段鄉事會會址附近起，向西南伸展約六十五米，再向東南伸展約十米；然後向西南伸展約八十五米，至與索罟灣第二街交界處止。在NTA/IS/R5B號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing near the North Lamma Community Centre and running generally in a easterly direction for about 160 metres where it bends to run south-easterly for about 65 metres; it then bends and runs in a generally south south-westerly direction for about 275 metres before it bends westerly for about 30 metres where it terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/IS/R6C.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由南丫北社區中心附近起，向東伸展約一百六十米，再向東南伸展約六十五米，後向西南偏南伸展約二百七十五米，再向西伸展三十米止。在NTA/IS/R6C號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing near Lot 363 in D.D. 3 Lamma Island, New Territories and running in a generally south south-westerly direction for about 105 metres where it terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/IS/R6C.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由新界南丫島第三約第三六三號地段附近起，向西南偏南伸展約一零五米止。在NTA/IS/R6C號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。
